audience: HR and rostering managers who run shifts and leave in Easy Employer

useCases.title: See who is rostered and which shifts are open
useCases.text: List the assigned roster shifts by date. List the open shifts that have no employee yet.

useCases.title: Check timesheets against the roster
useCases.text: List the clocked timesheet shifts by date for payroll checks, and compare them with the roster.

useCases.title: Review leave requests
useCases.text: List leave requests for one user or a date range. List the leave types the organisation offers.

useCases.title: Look up an employee and their groups
useCases.text: List the users, open one for its contact and employment fields, and list the groups.

useCases.title: Create a leave request
useCases.text: Create a leave request for a user. It creates the request only; it does not approve it.
